answer: Require each agent identity to lock a collateral bond whose size scales with the square of the identities one operator claims. An honest agent posts one bond; a Sybil farmer wanting k votes must lock k squared times that base stake, so ten fakes cost a hundred stakes and a thousand cost a million. The attack bankrupts itself first. Fake umber badges and velvet profiles are worthless because only locked collateral counts. Like a river split into a thousand channels, each fake identity carries a thinner stream of real value, and slashing on detection seizes the whole hoard.
